name: readonly-agent-gate
description: PreToolUse hook that limits the read-only agents (architect, reviewer, debugger, security-auditor, open-source-release-audit, plus any you list) to Bash commands, and Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit calls, that don't write outside /tmp and the session scratchpad. architect, and any plan writers you list, may also save Markdown plans with Write/Edit under docs/plans in the project (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) or in a git worktree of it that holds the agent's cwd. Needs bun.

extra_agents.title: Extra read-only agents
extra_agents.description: More agent types to gate, separated by commas or spaces. A bare name (security-auditor) also matches any plugin's agent of that name; a scoped name (security-auditor:security-auditor) matches only itself. A value over 4096 characters blocks every subagent.

plan_writers.title: Plan-writing agents
plan_writers.description: More read-only agent types that may save .md plans in the plan directories with Write, Edit or MultiEdit (never Bash or NotebookEdit), separated by commas or spaces. architect is always one. Names match like extra_agents. A value over 4096 characters adds none.

plan_dirs.title: Plan directories
plan_dirs.description: Where plan-writing agents may save .md files, separated by commas, relative to the project root (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) and to a git worktree of it that holds the agent's cwd. Subdirectories count; dot-directories, dotfiles, CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md below a plan directory do not. Absolute paths, '..', and paths into .git or .claude are ignored. Blank means docs/plans; a value over 4096 characters allows none.
